name: MoYu AoLong 3x3 V5 (Magnetic, Ball-Core, MagLev, UV Coated)
description: The MoYu AoLong 3x3 V5 (Magnetic, Ball-Core, MagLev, UV Coated) adds two meaningful upgrades over the spring versions: MagLev suspension replaces the springs for a faster, more fluid turning feel, and an 8-magnet ball-core brings auto-alignment into the mix. The result is 88 magnets working together — edge, corner, and core — with the same deep dual-axis tuning the whole V5 line shares.
features: 8-magnet ball-core: Eight magnets inside the ball core pull each corner piece into alignment as the layer settles — you feel it click into place precisely.
88-magnet total system: Corner, edge, and ball-core magnets form a complete magnetic field around every layer for feedback and stability from every angle.
UV Coated finish: High-grip glossy surface that holds under fast turning and sweaty hands.
Dual adjustment system: MagLev tension and distance are independently controlled — adjust feel and layer proximity without each setting fighting the other.
8 MagLev tension levels: Repelling magnets replace the spring — dial in the resistance from soft and fluid to firm and snappy.
8 distance settings: Set layer proximity to the core for the corner-cutting and stability profile you want.
